sourceRefs.locator: Inv. 56.449, Description, Mesures and Mode d’acquisition: gold and garnet, loop for fastening, 1.6 cm, 1.95 g, reported numbers at discovery and presentation, two recovered after the theft.

Namur copy R6A.0608. Printed p. 96, digitised page 119: Annuli aurei, middle row; p. 322, digitised page 348: insects with and without eyes, arranged in alternating orientations. Title and imprint: Antwerp, 1655.

summary.de: Ösen an der Rückseite erlaubten die Befestigung auf Leder oder dickem Stoff. Ein erhaltenes Exemplar hat Flügel mit Granateinlagen.
summary.en: Loops on the back allowed attachment to leather or heavy cloth. One surviving example has wings inlaid with garnets.
